approvedBy: Nell: '2' (2026-11-04), choosing the strategy temperature test
question: Does local strategy generation at temperature 0.3 name the faulted machine more reliably than the current 0.7?

design.config: Qwen3.5-4B-q4f16_1-MLC with the fast lane (Qwen3.5-0.8B routing at 914fde01), as shipped
design.repeats: 5 per arm (50 answers each), both arms in one page load, order alternating per repeat (0.7,0.3 then 0.3,0.7)
design.how: the eval overrides only requests that carry the strategy temperature (0.7); routing scores at temperature 1 are untouched; every overridden request is logged so the treatment arm is verified, not assumed

rule.adopt0.3if: hits(0.3) >= hits(0.7) + 3 AND parsed(0.3) >= parsed(0.7) AND median seconds(0.3) <= 1.2 x median seconds(0.7)
rule.otherwise: keep 0.7, which also keeps parity with the cloud models' setting
